blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Counsel for the prosecution Lorna Kapunan has clarified her previous statement about bullies, saying that it is Vice President Sara Duterte who can be considered a bully for her actions, and not her lead lawyer for the impeachment Sheila Sison. In an online interview on Thursday, Kapunan also apologized to Sison — whom she called a bully last Tuesday after a tense discussion due to the prosecution’s decision to withdraw three of the four Articles of Impeachment against Duterte.
